purpose: Combines regional adolescent nutrient-deficiency prevalence with demo genomic relevance.
important_note: This is a transparent research/demo prioritization score. It is not a clinical risk score or medical diagnosis. Genetic evidence modifies nutritional priority; it does not directly select a crop.
